verdict.rationale: A state business-filing agency could plausibly publish an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas, or a data dictionary for a machine channel, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no such specification. The probes show only that robots.txt on www.nvsos.gov and the esos/orion filing portal are hidden behind Akamai and Incapsula bot walls, and no spec, schema, or data dictionary is documented anywhere.
